settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.text_1:
Economy (5–8 business days) Free on $150+

2 Day Air (2–3 business days) $25+

Express (1–2 business days) $55
settings.text_2: We want you to be thrilled with your new TRUE footwear so we still offer a limited 30-day trial for any new footwear purchased directly through truelinkswear.com. We suggest trying on your shoes inside, before they are worn, to ensure proper fit and feel. However, if you do wear them outdoors and determine they’re not ideal within the first 30 days, you can arrange a one-time return for store credit or standard refund. A $25 trial fee will be deducted from your refund and a prepaid return ship label will be provided. You can utilize the 30 day trial once per calendar year. Applies to domestic orders only. Does not apply to Second Chance products as they are final sale.
settings.text_3: Second Chance models may contain new, slightly blemished, or gently used merchandise. All Second Chance models are FINAL SALE ONLY and not eligible for returns, exchanges, or any trial period. Original warranties are not valid on Second Chance items.
settings.text_4: For US direct orders, within 30 days of receipt, new and unworn footwear, apparel and select gear can be returned for: a one-time free exchange for size or color, a one-time free return for store credit (once issued, credit is non-refundable) or a flat $9 return for refund. If an item is returned worn, a $25 fee will apply per our 30 Day Trial. Does not apply to Second Chance products as they are final sale.

settings.custom_liquid:
<script type="text/javascript">
  var _learnq = _learnq || [];
  var item = {
    Name: {{ product.title|json }},
    ProductID: {{ product.id|json }},
    Categories: {{ product.collections|map:'title'|json }},
    ImageURL: "https:{{ product.featured_image.src|img_url:'grande' }}",
    URL: "{{ shop.secure_url }}{{ product.url }}",
    Brand: {{ product.vendor|json }},
    Price: {{ product.price|money|json }},
    CompareAtPrice: {{ product.compare_at_price_max|money|json }}
  };
  _learnq.push(['track', 'Viewed Product', item]);
  _learnq.push(['trackViewedItem', {
    Title: item.Name,
    ItemId: item.ProductID,
    Categories: item.Categories,
    ImageUrl: item.ImageURL,
    Url: item.URL,
    Metadata: {
      Brand: item.Brand,
      Price: item.Price,
      CompareAtPrice: item.CompareAtPrice
    }
  }]);

  function addedToCart() {
    fetch(`${window.location.origin}/cart.js`)
        .then(res => res.clone().json().then(data => {
          var cart = {
            total_price: data.total_price/100,
            $value: data.total_price/100,
            total_discount: data.total_discount,
            original_total_price: data.original_total_price/100,
            items: data.items
          }
          if (item !== 'undefined') {
            cart = Object.assign(cart, item)
          }
          _learnq.push(['track', 'Added to Cart', cart])
        }))
  }
  (function (ns, fetch) {
    ns.fetch = function() {
      const response = fetch.apply(this, arguments);
      response.then(res => {
        if (`${window.location.origin}/cart/add.js`
            .includes(res.url)) {
          addedToCart()
        }
      });
      return response
    }
  }(window, window.fetch))
</script>
